A token has been added to a URL in `README.md`. Committing secrets to a repository is a major security risk, as it can be used by malicious actors to gain unauthorized access to services.

Remove the token from the URL. If a token is required, it should be managed through repository secrets, not hardcoded.

1. In `README.md`, find the following markdown link: `[![DeepSource](https://deepsource.io/gh/deepsourcelabs/demo-ruby.svg/?label=active+issues&show_trend=true&token=GUiSpAVeA3v_yYb35jVt0I1V)](https://deepsource.io/gh/deepsourcelabs/demo-ruby/?ref=repository-badge)`
2. Remove the token parameter `&token=GUiSpAVeA3v_yYb35jVt0I1V` from the image URL.
3. The corrected line should be: `[![DeepSource](https://deepsource.io/gh/deepsourcelabs/demo-ruby.svg/?label=active+issues&show_trend=true)](https://deepsource.io/gh/deepsourcelabs/demo-ruby/?ref=repository-badge)`
4. This change reverts the URL to its previous state, removing the exposed secret and mitigating the security risk.
comments.impact_rationale: High probability (publicly visible), severe impact (account compromise), easy fix = Score 10.
